diagnostics.message:
Elements in iteration expect to have 'v-bind:key' directives. Element:
  • Help: Why: The :key attribute helps Vue's virtual DOM efficiently track and update list items. Fix: Add a unique identifier as the key:
  • {{ item.name }}
    • Best practices: - Use unique, stable identifiers (like database IDs) - Avoid using array index as key when list order may change - Keys must be primitive values (string or number)
